assetOnboardingSourceFile.description: Latest uploaded asset hierarchy file or spreadsheet containing the entity.

configurationLastUpdated.description: Indicates when the configuration of this asset was last updated.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

failureMode.description: The failure mode that contains this record

expectedSensor.description: Sensor to which the failure mode applies

diagnostic.description: The diagnostic to apply on the sensor data

sensorThreshold.description: The failure mode will be recommended if the {@link diagnostic} exceeds this threshold

failureModeLibrary.description: The failure mode library that contains this record

failureRecommendation.description: Recommended actions if this failure mode is recommended

isActive.description: Whether the {@link FailureModeLineItem} active. Represents if the {@link FailureModeLineItem} can be triggered.

title:
Do not persist this type. It is only used to return the result of the fetchWithActiveStatus function.
A {@link FailureModeLineItem} with an additional field to indicate whether it is active.
name: FailureModeLineItemWithActiveStatus
